name: ZEAL Network SE
summary: ZEAL Network SE engages in the online lottery brokerage business in Germany. The company operates through three segments: Germany, ONCE, and ZEAL Ventures. The company's lottery products include LOTTO 6aus49, Spiel 77, Super 6, Eurojackpot, GlücksSpirale, Keno, lotterys clubs, instant lotteries, and Deutsche Fernsehlotterie, as well as charity lotteries, including freiheit+ and Traumhausverlosung. It also engages in the operation of portals, such as Lotto24 and Tipp24 online lottery brokerage business; operation of games; and online lottery operation for the national organizations, as well as invests in lottery-related start-ups. The company was formerly known as Tipp24 SE and changed its name to ZEAL Network SE in November 2014. ZEAL Network SE was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Hamburg, Germany.
